# Immersive experiences (Apple Human Interface Guidelines)

**Page:** https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/immersive-experiences  
**Where:** [Human Interface Guidelines](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines) › [Foundations](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/foundations) › Immersive experiences  
**Parent skill:** `/hig-foundations`  
**Platforms:** visionOS only. The PDM app ships on iPhone, Android and the web, so this page applies only where it says something general; say so before applying it. Claude doesn't load this skill on its own; use it by name.  
**Last changed by Apple:** June 9, 2025

## How to use this skill

1. Read the page as it is today; don't work from memory. From the repository root:
   `python3 .claude/skills/hig/scripts/hig_page.py immersive-experiences`
   For one section: `python3 .claude/skills/hig/scripts/hig_page.py immersive-experiences --section <anchor>`, with an anchor from the list below.
2. Apply it to the task. The guidelines are written for Apple's frameworks; the PDM app is Expo / React Native, so translate each rule with [the hig skill's Expo notes](../hig/expo.md) and keep to [docs/frontend](../../../docs/frontend/README.md) (UI system, accessibility, platform adapters).
3. Cite the section link for every rule you apply and every finding you report.
